text: These glowing balls are Tide Pearls. Somebody is squeezing the tide into them, a little bit at a time.
Our spies found them on a necklace, in a pattern. Say the pattern out loud, then tap the pearl that's missing!
They're cold. And they sort of slosh.
That's the sea inside. And they're strung in patterns, so somebody is organised. We need to find out who.
Into the training pool, Rory. Air tank on, mask on. A spy diver can follow a line without getting tangled.
I've hung a Tide Pearl on one of the fishing lines. Follow its line up from the pearl, and tap the boat it hangs from.
Or you could just be a submarine. I am just saying.
Down I went, and up the line again. It's so quiet down there.
I stayed dry. I watched. It was very good swimming.
Climb in, Rory! You steer. I do the engine noises.
The bottom of the pool has coloured coral stones. Hop TORPEDO from stone to stone, following the colours, all the way to the arrow.
Wheee! Hop, hop, hop, and not one wrong stone. You are a natural. BOLT, did you see?
I saw. It was adequate.
Whoever is stealing the sea has little diving robots. Our spies call them Drips.
These are my practice ones. Press USE near a Drip and your watch pops it in a bubble!
The practice Drips say: blub.
That's all real Drips say too. It's very hard to interrogate them.
The submarine Narwhal is our base for this mission. It needs its supplies.
Oh no. My practice Drips jumbled the letters on the crate labels! Look at each picture, and tap the letters in order to spell it.
All loaded! The last crate is fish fingers. For you. Not for me. I run on batteries.
Good. The first harbour to dry out was Porthcarrow, in Cornwall. The Narwhal sails tonight.
Our harbour's on the mud! And Gran says things keep vanishing from it in the night.
Look through TORPEDO's porthole, Rory, and remember everything you see. Then tap the thing that's gone missing.
Something is sneaking off with things. And look, footprints in the mud. Little round ones.
Drip prints! They go towards the cave.
The cave is round the point. Two Drips with lanterns are guarding it.
I've drawn a sneaky path behind the rocks on the spy map. Follow the arrows from the star and tap where you end up.
I'm in. There's a pipe going down into the water. It's humming.
A pump! Something is pumping the sea away from here.
And look out there. A boat with no lights, going out to sea. Smugglers? Or Drips?
Look! Somebody on that boat is flashing a lamp. Long and short flashes.
That's Morse code. Each letter is a pattern of flashes. Use the chart and work out the message!
It says: PUMP ONE FULL. SEND TO FUNDY.
Somebody's sending the sea away. Let's switch off that pump first.
The pump's switch is right at the back of the flooded part of the cave.
I am small and slippery. I will squeeze in. Oh. The Drips have stacked crates and rocks all round me. I am stuck.
Slide them out of the way one square at a time, Rory, until TORPEDO can get out of the gap!
TORPEDO's free, and there's the switch. Pump off! The water's stopped going down the pipe.
Who switched off my pump?
Who said that?
Captain Undertow. Remember the name, little diver. The tide is turning.
That boat with no lights is getting away! It's full of pearls!
Take the jet-ski. Catch up and bump it three times!
Got it! The Drips jumped overboard. Blub, blub, blub.
And the pearls are going back into the sea. Look, the tide's coming in!
The old mill has sluice gates. When the pond fills, the wheel turns and powers the tide gauge.
Open and shut the gates to get the water up to the line in the mill pond.
The wheel's turning! The gauge is waking up.
It says the water is being pumped out of the bay from somewhere on the mudflats.
There they are! Drips, digging holes in the mudflats. They're burying pumps!
Ping the mud with TORPEDO's sonar, Rory. Red is hot and right next to it, blue is cold and far away. Find the pump!
We bubbled every Drip. They are floating away towards the sea. There is no sea.
They'll just float for a while then. But the tide gauge has gone dark. We need it to find the big pump.
The gauge needs power to track the pumps. The wires got muddled up.
Turn the tiles so the power runs from the mill to the gauge.
It's picked up the big pump. It's on a barge just off the shore road!
And somebody's driving away from the mill with the crank handle!
A Drip in a pickup truck! It's got the crank for the barge pump.
Take the buggy. Three bumps and it'll drop it!
Got the crank! Now let's get that barge.
Barges are just lazy boats.
We've got the crank! But the barge pump's switch has a word lock, and the Drips have jumbled the letters.
Look at each picture and tap the letters in order to spell it, Rory. The last word opens the lock.
PEARL! Of course it is. Crank in, switch off. Listen! The barge pump's stopped.
The bay is ready for its tide. Here it comes!
But the barge radio is still crackling. Somebody's heading south.
The locks are like steps for ships. Each chamber fills from the one above.
Open the valves in the right order to fill each chamber in turn.
The ship's floating again! Look at it rise!
The Drips hid pearls on the cargo ship in the lock. Every crate has a label, but it's in code!
Each symbol is a letter. Find it in the key, then tap the letters to spell the label.
It says MINE. And under it, a little wave and a U.
Captain Undertow? She's labelling the sea? That's so rude.
The Drips took over the lock control house. They ran off when they saw you coming, and left Undertow's logbook behind!
She hides her secret words in a jumble of letters. Tap the first letter of each word, then the last.
Ship, boat, pearl. It says barges come every night, and they all fill up from the lake. Somebody's draining it.
With valves under the lock gates. And the Drips are guarding the tunnel down there.
The valve wheel is in a flooded tunnel under the gates. TORPEDO can get in, but there are Drips sneaking about.
Look through TORPEDO's porthole, Rory, and remember everything. When a Drip squirts ink, tap the thing that's gone.
Caught it! The Drip dropped what it took and swam off. Valves shut! The lake stays in the lake.
A barge is racing away down the canal!
It's heading for the Pacific! Take my dad's speedboat!
Three bumps. Mind the channel markers.
The barge has stopped. It says sorry. In bubbles.
It's full of pearls! And a map of some islands.
The baby turtles hatched, but the sea is too far away now. And there are crabs!
I've marked a safe path on the spy map. Follow the arrows from the star, and tap where the babies reach the water.
They're swimming! Little flippers everywhere!
Mateo, why is that iguana blowing bubbles?
Some of those marine iguanas are Drips in costumes.
Real iguanas sneeze salt. Drips blow bubbles. Bubble the fake ones!
The costumes were very good. I would like one.
The Drips left a line of pearls across the old lava fields. It's like a trail!
The pearls go in a pattern. Find the missing one each time and we can follow the trail.
The trail stops here. At a radio mast that doesn't belong.
A Drip mast! It needs a code to switch off.
The mast plays a tune before it unlocks. Watch the lights and play it back.
Mast off! Its last message went to a salvage boat in the bay.
My turn! The Drips dropped pump parts on the sea bed, and they have sunk into the sand.
Ping the sand with TORPEDO's sonar, Rory. The hotter the colour, the closer you are. Find it, and TORPEDO will grab it with his claw.
I am a salvage submarine now. I have a new job title.
I also have a job title. Mine is BOLT.
The biggest part has a delivery label. Hawaii.
Something's wrong with the surf. The big waves are getting smaller every day. And somebody cut up my sea creature pictures at the surf hut!
Drips. Put the pictures back together, Rory. Tap a half on the top row, then its other half below.
You fixed them like a pro! Totally shredded it.
I don't know what that means but thank you.
Look, wet Drip prints, going back along the lava coast. Something along there is drinking the sea.
Look! A pipe going into a tunnel in the black lava rock. The only way there is across the coral.
Don't break any coral, Rory. Hop TORPEDO across the stones in the colour pattern, all the way to the arrow.
That's an old lava tube. Like a cave the lava made.
And the pipe goes all the way in. So do a lot of lasers.
I've switched the lasers off. At the end of the tube there's a huge machine with a name plate.
Be careful, Rory. It's hot in there. And the name is in code!
Use the key. Swap each symbol for its letter.
DIGGER. It says DRIP DIGGER. It's drilling into the rock!
That sounds big. Where's its owner?
A Drip boat is towing a pearl net along the cliffs! But there are fishing lines everywhere, all tangled up.
Follow the line up from the pearl net and tap the boat it's tied to, Rory. Then the coastguard can cut the net.
Net cut! The pearls are sinking back where they belong.
Enough! Drip Digger, show them what you can do.
My Drip Digger drills through lava rock like butter. Imagine what it does to spies.
When it stomps, a ring of steam rolls out. JUMP over it! Then zap it from behind.
It's popped into a bubble!
Oh, very clever. You've stopped one little pump. My Engine is bigger than a mountain, and you'll never reach it.
Engine? What engine?
I don't know. But I don't like the sound of it.
The outer reef drops off like a cliff, down and down into the blue. The way down is all coral.
Mum marks a safe path in a colour pattern, so nobody breaks the coral.
Hop TORPEDO along the coral, following the colours, to the arrow.
It goes down and down. And there's a pipe, in the canyon at the bottom!
It goes right into the dark.
It's pitch black in the pipe. But TORPEDO's sonar can draw a map of it!
Ping! There. A map. I am very clever.
Follow the arrows from the star, Rory, and tap where the Drips' markers lead.
The pipe opens out. There's a pump bigger than a house.
We need to block its intake.
Help! The pump sucked me in among the boulders. I am wedged. I am not enjoying it.
Slide the rocks one square at a time, Rory, until TORPEDO can get out of the gap. Then we'll roll them into the pipe.
TORPEDO's out, and the rocks rolled right into the pipe. Blocked! The water's stopped going down.
Some Drips are still guarding the pump though.
The Drips are swimming round the pump.
Swim up close and zap them into bubbles. They're slippery underwater.
Six bubbles floating up. It looks like a lemonade.
The pump scared the fish out of their homes. And the Drips cut up Mum's fish survey cards!
Put the cards back together, Rory, so Mum can see who's back. Tap a half on the top row, then its other half below.
All the cards are mended, and everybody's home. Mum's going to be so pleased.
And I've found the pump's records. A whole fleet of cargo ships, in Hong Kong.
Grandpa watches every boat in the harbour. He says Drips are lowering crates over the side on long lines!
Follow the line up from the pearl crate, Rory, and tap the boat it hangs from.
Grandpa says it all goes to one ship. The big grey cargo ship.
Then that's where the pearls are.
That's the ship. The containers are full of pearls.
One of the crew is Undertow's spy, and they have the captain's log. Read the clues and tap the spy, Rory.
Got it! The log is in code. Morse code.
There's a radio room on the bridge. Let's listen in.
Undertow is sending a message. Listen to the beeps and match them to the chart.
It says: ALL PEARLS TO MALDIVES. THE ISLANDS ARE READY.
Islands made of pearls? What is she up to?
The biggest container has a lock that plays a tune.
Watch it light up, then play it back.
It's full of machinery. Parts of something huge. Stamped TIDAL ENGINE.
There is the engine. I still do not like the sound of it.
The cargo ship's launch is escaping with the engine plans!
Chase it through the harbour. Mind the junks!
Plans got! They show islands in the Maldives with pipes going down into the sea.
Good luck, Rory! Come back for the light show!
New sandbanks keep popping up in our lagoon. The water's going down and down!
Something's hidden in that sandbank. Ping it with TORPEDO's sonar, Rory. Hot or cold, find it!
The sandbanks are full of pipes. They're pumping the lagoon dry from underneath.
The pipes have sluice gates. Maybe we can make them work backwards.
The pipes have sluice gates. If we can open the right ones, the water flows back.
Get every lagoon up to its line. Some gates fill two at once!
The lagoon is filling! The fish are coming back in.
The Drips are hiding in the water villas, and one of the guests is letting them in!
Read the clues, Rory. Which guest is working for Undertow? Tap them.
Got you! And the Drips are in that villa.
They were watching television. It was a programme about the sea. They were taking notes.
There's a wire from the villa to a control box. For all the island pumps!
All the island pumps are wired to one control box. Turn the tiles to cut the power.
Pumps off! But a seaplane is taking off with Undertow's maps!
It's still on the water! Catch it before it takes off!
Bump its floats three times and it'll have to stop.
It's stopped! The Drip pilot is waving a white flag. A very small one.
And here are the maps. Every pump she has leads to one place. The Bermuda Triangle.
That's her base, right in the middle of the Triangle. The deck is crawling with Drip guards.
They're all looking the other way. Quick, the main hatch has a word lock. Find every word hidden in its letters!
I'm in. It's a huge hall full of pipes.
And lasers. Lots of lasers.
The laser switch is a necklace of Tide Pearls. Find the missing pearl in the pattern and the beams go off.
I would help but I am a submarine and this is a corridor.
Beams off! There's a control room on the far side.
This panel sends power to every pump in the world. Cut it!
Pumps off, everywhere! Harbours are filling up all over the world!
You think this is my Engine? This is a pantry. My Engine is where you will never follow.
Look down through the floor! There's a submarine under the base.
It's shaped like a squid.
Meet my Kraken. It's a robot squid, and it's very cross.
Jump the rings, and zap its battery pack when it turns round. Four hits!
My Kraken! Very well. Keep your little harbours. The ocean is mine.
She's diving! The whole base is going under!
In you get, Rory! We are not losing her now. Oh no. The sinking base is dropping crates all round us!
Slide the crates and rocks out of the way, Rory, until TORPEDO can get out and follow Undertow's sub down.
She is gone. Down there. Where it is dark.
We'll find her, TORPEDO. Whatever the Tidal Engine is.
Oh no! My underwater camera fell over the side, and it's caught on a fishing line.
Lots of boats, lots of lines, all crossed over. Follow the line from the camera up to its boat, Rory.
Got it! Here's your camera, Dr Lani.
I could have fetched that. Show-off.
Thank you! Something's scaring the animals in the warm current. Let's go and see.
The turtles ride the warm current like a road. I keep a picture card of everything that swims along it.
But the Drips have cut Lani's cards in half! Tap a top half, Rory, then its other half.
All mended. But hardly anyone's on the current today. They're all swimming away from the same spot.
The spot where that humming noise is coming from?
Let's take a look.
Drip divers! They're laying a pipe along the sea bed.
They've marked the way with a string of Tide Pearls, in a pattern. Which pearl comes next, Rory?
Got it! The Drips have lost their place. They've all swum off.
Their pipe starts at the old sunken base. And it goes a long way.
The sunken base is too dark to see in. I pinged the sonar and put Undertow's markers on the spy map.
Follow the directions one square at a time, Rory, and tap where you end up.
Her markers all point the same way. West.
Along the pipe. And look, a Drip sub is following it!
A Drip sub is following the pipe. Let us follow the Drip sub!
Stay close, through the rings it leaves behind.
It went into the kelp. I do not like kelp. It tickles.
The Drips left nets all over the sea bed. TORPEDO lifted them out, but somebody keeps putting them back.
One of those fishermen on the pier is a Drip in disguise! Read the clues, Rory, and tap the spy.
That one! I can see its little robot feet.
Every net gone, and a Drip caught. I am a hero.
Look out! Its friends are getting away in a sub!
A Drip sub, heading for the deep water!
Through the kelp? It tickles! Fine. Fine!
It dropped something. A picture of an old ship.
The Drips have a big machine cutting down the kelp, to make room for the pipe.
And they have boxed me in with crates and rocks! I cannot reach its off switch.
Slide them out of the way, Rory, one square at a time, until TORPEDO can get out of the gap.
It's stopped! The kelp will grow back. It grows really fast.
The Drips left markers in the thickest part of the forest. Let's find them.
The kelp's so thick you can't see a thing. But the sonar found a Drip marker with a coded note on it.
Use the key, Rory. Swap each symbol for its letter.
WRECK. The markers point out to sea, towards the wreck in the picture.
Oh no. Where are the otter pups?
A pup got lost in all the fuss, and now it's caught on a fishing line!
The lines are all tangled. Follow the pup's line up to its boat, Rory, and TORPEDO will snip it free.
Free, and back with its mum! Look, they're holding hands.
That is the best thing I have ever seen.
The front of the ship still has air in it. Get in through the old cargo door.
Close the outer door, pump the water out, then open the inner one. In that order!
I'm in a room with air in it, at the bottom of the sea. That's so weird.
Drip guards in the ballroom. They're guarding a door with a word lock.
The ballroom. Marina used to dance here with her grandfather.
The lock words are hidden in the ship's old logbook. Find them all, Rory.
Someone's been living here! A camp bed, a lamp, and pictures of the sea all over the walls.
Marina's old cabin. She came back.
Undertow's pipe runs through the old engine room. The pressure's all wrong.
Turn the valves until every gauge is green. Then the pipe stops pumping.
All green! That pipe's stopped.
Stop one pipe, Agent Rory, and I have a hundred more.
The captain's safe fell out of the ship when she sank. Someone has buried it in the sand.
Find it, and I will pull it out with my claw.
Ping the sand with TORPEDO's sonar, Rory. The hotter the colour, the closer you are.
Inside there's a logbook. It's Marina's.
She kept it all these years.
Wait. The ship's creaking. Rory, she's moving!
The ship's moving! She's sliding off the ledge!
Everybody out! Follow the rings and don't stop!
We made it. The Neptune is sleeping again.
Goodbye, old girl.
The pipe comes in here somewhere, but it's too dim to see.
The Drips bury a marker next to their pipe. Ping the sand, Rory. The hotter the colour, the closer you are.
Found it. It's huge, and it's humming.
Oh dear. The noise has scared the lanternfish right out of their shoal.
The lanternfish want to come home, but a Drip keeps squirting ink and snatching things off the sea bed.
Look out of TORPEDO's porthole, Rory, and remember everything. When the ink clears, spot what the Drip took.
They're coming home! Listen. The shoal is singing again. Well, clicking.
And look. A Drip beacon, flashing right by the pipe.
A Drip beacon, flashing a code to someone. Crack it!
It says: Tidal Engine. Mariana. Glass Station ready.
The Mariana Trench. The deepest place in the world.
Headlights on! Through the rings, down the canyon.
I did not hit a single thing. Write that down.
Three pipes meet here. Balance the valves and they'll all stop.
Silence! You did it.
Clever. But the deeper you go, Agent Rory, the darker it gets.
I draw every creature that drifts through the canyon, for my creature book!
But the Drips tore all my pictures in half.
Help Glim, Rory. Tap a top half, then the half that matches it.
Lovely. Now I'll draw Gerald. He's bigger than a bus.
You'll need a bigger page.
Oh! Drips! With lamps on their heads!
Drips! They've got lamps on their heads. That's how you'll see them.
Bubbled! That was the most exciting thing that's happened to me in two years.
We need a map of the canyon. The sonar found the Drips' survey markers, so I've put them on the spy map.
Follow the directions one square at a time, Rory. Tap where the pipe ends up.
Got it. The pipe goes straight down to the hydrothermal vents.
Look! The flashing from far below. It's started again.
Someone's been flashing a lamp from far below. Every night. The same message.
Read the flashes, Rory.
It says: I think I have made a terrible mistake. Signed: S.
S? Who's S?
My battery's so flat, my words are coming out all jumbled!
A little probe! I have plenty of charge.
Unjumble Glim's words, Rory. Tap the letters in the right order.
Charging! Oh, that's lovely. Thank you, TORPEDO.
You can sit in my glovebox. I have never used it.
The Drips have stuck Tide Pearls round the chimneys, in a pattern. Keep out of the hot water!
Some pearls have fallen off. Say the pattern out loud, Rory, and work out which pearl is missing.
Not a single burn. Well done!
These pearls are warm. Something's using the heat.
Undertow's pump house. It's just over there.
Undertow's pump house runs on vent heat. Reroute the power and switch it off.
The pumps have stopped! The pipe to the Engine is running dry.
A Drip sub is getting away through the chimneys!
Mind the smoke. It's very hot.
Caught its trail. It went towards the glass lights.
The Drips knocked my sensor sled over, right out in the vent field.
Hop TORPEDO across the coral to fetch it, Rory. Follow the colours, and keep away from the hot chimneys!
Now I can watch the vents again. And look at all the Drip subs it saw going by!
All heading for the glass lights.
This is where the vent heat goes into the Engine's pipes. Balance the valves to shut it off.
The chimneys are calm again.
You're getting close, Agent Rory. Too close.
The station's airlock. Outer door, pumps, inner door. Don't mix them up!
I'm in. It smells of coffee and seaweed.
Drip guards all through the labs. Sneak to the top dome.
Oh! A child? In a diving suit? How did you get in here?
I'm Professor Silt. Undertow's watching me. I can only talk with the lamp. Read my flashes.
He says he built the Engine because she told him it would save the sea.
She said the sea was in danger. That we'd keep it safe.
The Engine's plans are locked in her safe. Crack the code.
What? Ice bricks? A space elevator? To Mars?
She never told me. She's not keeping the sea safe. She's taking it away!
The alarms! Someone told her I've been talking to you.
One of those people is a Drip in disguise. Read the clues, Rory, and tap the spy.
That one! There's a Drip aerial poking out from under its hat.
Then quick, to the moon pool! Oh, I haven't run like that in forty years.
Everyone in! Professor, you can sit next to Glim.
Thank you, Agent Rory. Now let's stop her. Together.
There's no surface here, just ice. You breathe at the air holes.
My dad found a safe way to the next air hole, across the coloured coral. Follow the colours, Rory, and hop TORPEDO over.
You'd make a great ice diver.
The factory's just ahead. Listen. Chop, chop, freeze.
The factory floor. Drip guards everywhere, and her logbook on the desk.
It lists what she freezes into the cargo pods. Find the hidden words, Rory.
Fish, crabs, shells, even whole waves. All the sea she's stolen, frozen into bricks.
The freezer controls are past the conveyor belts. Follow me.
I designed this freezer. Cut the power here, and here, and it stops.
The freezer's off! The bricks will melt back into the sea.
A Drip sub with the last load of bricks! Through the ice tunnels!
It dropped the bricks. The sea gets them back.
The narwhals are trapped behind the factory's crates and rocks. And now TORPEDO's stuck in there too!
Slide them out of the way, Rory. Get me out of the gap, and the narwhals can follow me.
You did it! They're out, and they're singing! Can you hear them?
I recorded it. I'm keeping it forever.
The first pressure door. The order matters. Get it wrong and the door won't budge.
Perfect. Now down, and down, and down.
The Engine pulls a current down the trench wall. Ride it!
So deep. And it's all still alive down here.
It always is.
Every pipe from every ocean joins here. Balance it and the whole network slows down.
Harbours are filling up again all over the world!
Her supply sled crashed on the trench floor. Her new logbook's in it.
She writes it in code. Use the key, Rory. Swap each symbol for its letter.
It says: the cargo pod goes up the space elevator tomorrow. To MARS.
A space elevator. She really did it.
And her map shows the Engine's entrance. Look. A door the size of a church.
The last door. Her code. I think I know how she thinks. Let's try.
It's opening. Good luck, Agent Rory.
Welcome to the Tidal Engine.
The intake valves. Balance them all and the Engine can't drink any more sea.
My intakes! Drips! Stop that child!
The Drips are coming. I will block the door. I am very wide.
The heart of the Engine. Cut the power to it. I'll talk you through it.
It's stopping! The Engine is stopping!
Then meet my Kraken. The new one. The bigger one.
It is the Kraken again. It has more arms this time.
Same trick! Jump the rings and zap its battery pack. Five hits this time.
Enough! If I can't have the Engine, I'll take what I've already got.
She's in a cargo pod full of ice bricks, heading for the elevator!
Her Drips are grabbing the last things to take with her. Look through my porthole, Rory, and remember everything.
When the Drip squirts ink, spot what's been taken!
She's taken it with her! And the pod's moving.
After her! Hold on to something, everybody!
We are too late. She is at the lift.
The elevator goes up through the sea, and its doors have word locks. Her Drips jumbled the letters!
She always used the same last word. The thing she loves most.
Tap the letters in the right order, Rory, and follow her as far as you can!
She's out of the water. Going up and up, into the sky.
Goodbye, Agent Rory. Look for me on Mars.
The Drips have been at my rocket. Before it flies, I need to know if they've taken anything.
Look through my porthole, Rory. Remember everything you can see.
Then a Drip will squirt ink. When it clears, tap the thing that's gone.
Good spotting. But hang on. My spare fuel pod was on the deck. Where's it gone?
There! A Drip boat, zooming off with it!
A Drip boat just took a rocket fuel pod!
Grab a jet-ski. Bump them three times and they'll drop it.
Fuel pod back! And a very wet Drip.
Jet-skis. Always showing off on top of the water.
There are still Drips hiding all over the platform! One is dangling under the deck on a fishing line.
The lines are all tangled. Follow the line from the Drip up to its boat, and tap the boat.
Then we can reel them in.
Found every one. They're blowing bubbles at me.
That means they're sorry. I think.
This one's holding pliers. They've been in launch control, crossing my wires!
They crossed the wires in launch control. Nothing talks to the rocket.
Turn the tiles to join the power back up.
Launch control is online. Now for the countdown.
The launch code is locked. The Drips changed it.
They left clues in their bubbles. Crack the code!
Three, two, one... lift off!
Wow. Look at it go.
And now, Agent Rory, you have an elevator to catch.
The anchor station's full of Drip guards with searchlights.
Sneak through to the control room. Stay out of the light!
My control room! I missed it so much.
Somebody locked my climber bay and took the pass. One of my engineers is working for Undertow!
My cameras saw them. Here's what they look like.
Read the clues, Rory. Tap the one who fits every clue.
Got you! And here's the bay pass. Is that the climber? It's tiny.
It's cosy. But her helper left the motors running hot.
The climber motors get very hot. The coolant valves are all wrong.
Turn the wheels until every gauge is in the green.
Nice and cool. She'll climb like a rocket now.
I rigged the top of the ribbon to flash a message. Read it for me?

Somebody is squeezing the sea into glowing Tide Pearls. That's why harbours are drying out.
This mission happens under the water. A spy diver always fills the air tank before going down.
TORPEDO is a yellow robot submarine. He can carry Rory deep down, where a diver on their own can't go.
The sea thief's diving robots are called Drips. A bubble from Rory's watch pops them away. All they ever say is blub.
The first harbour to dry out was Porthcarrow, in Cornwall. The Narwhal is sailing there.
Little round Drip footprints lead from the harbour to the smugglers' cave round the point.
A pump in the cave is sucking the sea out of the harbour. A boat with no lights is waiting out at sea.
The boat's lamp flashed: PUMP ONE FULL. SEND TO FUNDY. Somebody is sending the sea away.
The sea thief is called Captain Undertow. The pumps belong to her, and she says the tide is turning.
Undertow's pump has her mark on it: a wave and the letter U. Its logbook says the next stop is the Bay of Fundy, in Canada.
The tide gauge says the bay's water is being pumped out from somewhere on the mudflats.
The Drips planted little pumps all over the mudflats. Somewhere there's a big one doing most of the work.
The big pump is on a barge just off the shore road. A Drip has driven off with its crank handle.
Rory got the crank handle back. With it, the barge pump can be switched off.
Undertow's boat got away, heading south. The barge radio caught where to: the Panama Canal.
The canal's locks are steps of water for ships. Somebody has been letting the water out, and the ships got stuck.
Undertow labels every pearl crate MINE. She thinks the sea belongs to her.
Every night the Drips open valves under the lock gates and drain the lake into barges.
The valves are shut and the lake is safe. But one last barge full of pearls is escaping down the canal.
The barge was full of pearls, with a map of the Galápagos Islands, out in the Pacific Ocean.
Some of the iguanas on the beach are blowing bubbles. Real iguanas sneeze salt. Drips blow bubbles.
The bubbly iguanas were Drips in costumes. They had been hiding pearls up on the old lava fields.
The pearl trail leads to a Drip radio mast on the lava fields. It's sending messages.
The mast's last message went to a salvage boat in the bay. It's hiding parts of a pump.
The pump parts were going to Hawaii. Undertow is using the volcanoes for something.
Hawaii's waves get smaller every day. Something on the lava coast is pumping the sea away.
A big pipe runs into an old lava tube, a cave the lava made. Undertow has filled it with lasers.
Undertow's Drip Digger drills through lava rock. It's at the end of the lava tube.
Undertow has sent her Drip Digger out of the lava tube to stop Rory.
Undertow has an Engine far, far bigger than the Digger. The Digger's memory shows a pipe on the Great Barrier Reef.
A giant pipe runs down a canyon in the reef wall, and into the dark.
Inside the pipe is a pump bigger than a house. Blocking its mouth will stop it.
The big pump's mouth is plugged with boulders. Only its Drip guards are left.
The pump's Drip guards are bubbled. But the pump scared the reef fish out of their homes.
The reef pump's records show a fleet of cargo ships in Hong Kong. Undertow is shipping pearls somewhere.
Drips are carrying pearls from the junks to one big grey cargo ship in the harbour.
Undertow's spy on the cargo ship had the captain's log. It's written in Morse code.
Undertow's radio message said: ALL PEARLS TO MALDIVES. THE ISLANDS ARE READY.
The biggest container is full of machine parts stamped TIDAL ENGINE. That's Undertow's Engine.
The stolen plans show new islands in the Maldives, with pipes going down into the sea.
The new islands are full of pipes, pumping the lagoon dry from underneath.
The sluices are open and the lagoon is filling. But the Drips have hidden themselves in the water villas.
All the island pumps are wired to one control box. Cut its power and they all stop.
The island pumps are off, but a Drip seaplane is trying to take off with Undertow's maps.
Every one of Undertow's pumps leads to one place: the Bermuda Triangle.
Under the main hatch is a huge hall full of pipes, guarded by lasers.
Past the lasers is a control room with a panel that powers every pump in the world.
Every pump is off. Undertow has a submarine shaped like a squid, waiting under her base.
The Kraken is beaten. But Undertow is diving, and she's taking her whole base down with her.
Undertow dived deeper than TORPEDO has ever been, down to her Tidal Engine in the abyss.
Rory saved Dr Lani's camera. Something is scaring the sea animals near Lani's boat.
The fish and turtles are all swimming away from a humming noise on the sea bed.
The Drips are laying a long pipe along the sea bed. It starts at Undertow's sunken base.
Undertow's markers in the sunken base all point west, along the pipe. A Drip sub is following it.
The Drip sub went into a kelp forest off the coast of California. The pipe goes that way too.
The Drips dress up as fishermen to put their nets back. Their friends are escaping in a sub.
The Drip sub dropped a picture of an old ship as it got away.
The Drips were cutting the kelp to make room for their pipe. They left markers deep in the forest.
The Drip markers point out to sea, towards the old shipwreck in the picture.
The otters are safe. The pipe goes out to sea, towards a famous shipwreck.
Rory is inside the sunken liner, in a room that still has air in it.
Behind the ballroom is a little cabin with a camp bed and sea pictures. Undertow has been living here.
One pipe has stopped, but Undertow says she has a hundred more. The captain's safe may say where.
The safe held Marina Undertow's logbook. It says the pipe goes down, into the dark.
The Neptune slid off the ledge, but everyone got out. The pipe goes down to the dim Twilight Zone.
Undertow's pipe runs through the Twilight Zone. Its hum is scaring the animals.
The lanternfish are home. Near the pipe, a Drip beacon is flashing a secret code.
The beacon said: Tidal Engine. Mariana. Glass Station ready. The Mariana Trench is the deepest place in the world.
TORPEDO followed the pipe down the canyon, to a junction where three pipes meet.
The junction is quiet. The pipe goes on down into the Midnight Zone, where there's no light at all.
Glim spotted Drip divers in the canyon. They wear lamps on their heads, so you can see them.
The Drips were putting survey markers down the canyon, to show where the pipe goes.
The canyon map shows the pipe going straight down to the hot hydrothermal vents.
Somebody called S flashes the same message every night: I think I have made a terrible mistake.
Glim is charged up and riding in TORPEDO's glovebox. Next stop: the vents, where the sea floor is hot.
Undertow's pump house is next to the chimneys. It runs on heat from the vents.
The pump house is off, so the pipe to Undertow's Engine is running dry. A Drip sub is trying to escape.
The Drip sub escaped through the chimneys towards some glowing glass lights.
Dr Ama's sensors saw lots of Drip subs going past, all heading for the glass lights.
The heat pipes go north-west, to a station made of glass. That's where S's flashing comes from.
Rory is inside the Glass Station. It smells of coffee and seaweed, and it's full of Drip guards.
In the top dome is a scientist in glasses. He must be S, the one flashing the lamp.
Professor Silt built the Tidal Engine, because Undertow told him it would save the sea.
The plans show the Engine freezes the sea into ice bricks, to send up a space elevator to Mars.
Professor Silt has escaped with Rory. He wants to help stop Undertow and her Engine.
Undertow's ice brick factory is hidden under the Arctic ice. Its noise scares the narwhals.
The factory freezes the sea into ice bricks and sends them off in cargo pods, every day.
The freezer is off, so the ice bricks will melt back into the sea. One Drip sub still has a load.
The last Drip sub dropped its bricks. Now only the trapped narwhals are left to free.
The narwhals are free and the bricks are gone. Now there's only the Tidal Engine, in the Mariana Trench.
Rory is through the first pressure door. The Engine is still a long way further down.
At the bottom of the trench, every pipe from every ocean joins into one Great Pipe.
The Great Pipe has slowed down. Harbours all over the world are filling up again.
Undertow's cargo pod goes up a space elevator to Mars tomorrow. The Engine's giant door is just ahead.
The last door is open. Below it is the Tidal Engine, the biggest machine ever built under the sea.
The Engine can't drink any more sea. Now its glowing heart must be switched off.
The Engine's heart has stopped. Undertow has sent her new, bigger Kraken.
The Kraken is beaten. Undertow is escaping in a cargo pod full of ice bricks, heading for the space elevator.
Undertow's cargo pod has reached the space elevator. It goes straight up through the sea.
Undertow escaped up the space elevator to Mars. But the Engine has stopped, and the sea is flowing back.
The Drips stole a rocket fuel pod. One of their boats is racing off across the sea with it.
The fuel pod is back. The wet Drip says lots of its friends are still hiding on the platform.
The Drips sneaked into launch control and crossed the wires. Now nothing can talk to the rocket.
Launch control can talk to the rocket again. Only the launch code is left, and the Drips changed it.
The rocket can carry the supplies, but no passengers. So Rory will ride up Undertow's own space elevator.
Otis has his control room back. His climber is in the climber bay, but somebody has locked it.
One of the engineers was Undertow's helper. Rory got the bay pass back and found Otis's climber.
The climber motors are cool again. Otis's friend at the dock is flashing a message from the top of the ribbon.
The message said RACE. Undertow's climber is already on its way up the ribbon!
Rory beat Undertow's climber to the Orbital Dock. TORPEDO is riding along in Vega's supply rocket, in a box.
Every crate on Undertow's ship is labelled JEZERO: a crater on Mars that used to be a lake. That's where she is taking the sea.
Rory is back inside the dock. Undertow wiped the star charts so nobody could follow her to Mars.
Juno plotted the way to Mars by the stars. Now to find out what's inside Undertow's ship.
Undertow's ship is full of ice bricks: real sea, frozen solid. She's taking it all to Mars.
Rory is hiding on Undertow's ship, bound for Mars. Vega and TORPEDO are following in the supply rocket.
Undertow's ship landed on Phobos with a big bump. Tycho's mining bots got scared and ran off across the crater.
The mining bots are home and happy. But her ship knocked out the station's lights.
The station lights are back on. From Phobos, Tycho can see every star, and the way to Mars.
The stars point straight at Mars. Undertow's ship dropped some of its cargo before heading there.
Her bricks are real sea, frozen hard. Her ship has flown down to Mars, to a place called Jezero Crater.
Jezero Crater was a lake long ago. Undertow's Drips have been seen up on the crater rim.
From up high, the helicopter saw Drip tracks by the greenhouse, and three mini-rovers chasing Undertow's ship.
The greenhouse plants are watered. But Amani's three mini-rovers are still lost out in the crater.
The mini-rovers found a locked map case that a Drip dropped. It has a picture code lock.
Undertow's map shows a pipe running up the Valles Marineris canyon, all the way to the north pole.
The Drip rover was carrying parts for her pipe. The pipe runs along the canyon floor, behind a laser fence.
Rory got past the lasers to the pipe. Its valves control how fast the water flows to Undertow.
The pipe has slowed right down. A pump station somewhere down the canyon pushes the water along.
Undertow's pump station is halfway down the canyon cliff. Her plans are kept inside.
Undertow keeps the ice at the north pole, with her dome right next to it. Her dust storm is in the way.
The Drip yacht had one of her giant storm fans. The fans make the storm, and it hides the path north.
The beacons light the path through the storm. Undertow's own Drips are being blown about in it.
All of Undertow's storm fans are worked from one weather station. Switch it off, and the storm stops.
The storm fans are slowing down. Her Drips are flashing signals to each other through the dust.
The Drips are heading for the summit of Olympus Mons. Undertow's radio is up there.
At the top of Olympus Mons, her Drips have fenced off the crater with a locked laser gate.
Undertow's radio mast stands in the middle of the crater. It's locked with a code.
Her radio says the ice towers are ready, the dome is full and the Engine is running. The towers are at the north pole.
The climbers' greenhouse is green again. But Undertow heard us on her radio, and something big is stirring in the crater.
The Dust Kraken is beaten. Undertow is waiting at the north pole, and Professor Silt is there too.
Undertow is melting more towers every day. The melt switch is on the far side of her brick yard.
Rory sneaked past the guards to the melt switch. It's wired up like a puzzle.
The towers have stopped melting. But there's a crack in the ice between us and Undertow's dome.
The brick bridge is built. Silt kept a star chart of the way to the dome, but the Drips scrambled it.
Undertow's dome is just over the ridge. Inside is a whole sea, and the Tidal Engine.
Rory is inside the dome. Undertow has filled its sea with Tide Pearls from all over Earth.
The Tidal Engine is at the bottom of the dome sea. Its valves decide which way the water goes.
The Engine is turned round, so the sea can go home. Undertow is very, very cross.
Undertow has stopped fighting. She is going to help send the sea home.
The stolen sea is going back to Earth as rain, falling on every harbour in the world.
